usage: agentware fanout teardown [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--repo REPO]
                                 [--kb-repo KB_REPO]
                                 [--integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH]
                                 [--force] [--dry-run]
                                 features [features ...]

positional arguments:
  features              lane(s) to tear down

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --repo REPO           package repo (default: this agentware repo)
  --kb-repo KB_REPO     KB repo (default: the resolved knowledge dir)
  --integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH
                        integration branch for the merged check (default:
                        integration)
  --force               remove even unmerged/dirty lanes (R-GIT-02 override)
  --dry-run             print what would be removed; remove nothing
